Name: Device Mode
Description: Device mode to use. Available/accepted modes are determined by the several device HW and SW configuration. (0=M2M / 1=LW+M2M CONFIG / 2=LW SLEEPER 3=M2M SLEEPER)

Name: Report Interval
Description: Reporting data interval. The accepted values are determined by the several device HW and SW configuration. It is applicable to all reporting protocols (MQTT/LoRaWAN/...).

Name: Night Mode Enable
Description: Enables or disables the Night Mode. When enabled the device enters deep-sleep during the configured time window.

Name: Night Mode Start
Description: Specifies the start time of the Night Mode window in HH:MM format (GMT+0). Supports overnight windows (start > end). The device enters deep-sleep at this time when Night Mode is enabled.

Name: Night Mode End
Description: Specifies the end time of the Night Mode window in HH:MM format (GMT+0). Supports overnight windows (start > end). The device wakes up at this time when Night Mode is enabled.

Name: Request Report
Description: Force to send one shot report

Name: Use GNSS Location
Description: Instructs to the device to report GNSS location acquired (enabled) or user-specified location (disabled)

Name: Latitude
Description: Specifies the latest latitude value reported from the device GNSS when 'Use GNSS Location' is enabled or the latitude value established by the user when 'Use GNSS Location' is disabled.

Name: Longitude
Description: Specifies the latest longitude value reported from the device GNSS when 'Use GNSS Location' is enabled or the longitude value established by the user when 'Use GNSS Location' is disabled.

Name: Altitude
Description: Specifies the latest altitude value reported from the device GNSS when 'Use GNSS Location' is enabled or the altitude value established by the user when 'Use GNSS Location' is disabled.

Name: Speed
Description: Specifies the latest speed value reported from the device GNSS when 'Use GNSS Location' is enabled or the speed value established by the user when 'Use GNSS Location' is disabled.

Name: Fixed GPS
Description: This parameter indicates the fixation status (true or false) of the GPS signal. It confirms whether the modem has successfully triangulated its position with the satellites.

Name: DNS Primary server
Description: Primary DNS (Domain Name System) to use to resolve domain names. Commonly useful for specific cases such as VPN.

Name: SSID
Description: Specifies the Wi-Fi SSID that the Smart Spot will use to connect to the internet via Wi-Fi.

Name: Password
Description: Specifies the Wi-Fi password that the Smart Spot will use to connect to the internet via Wi-Fi.

Name: Enable Default WiFi
Description: Instructs the device on whether it should attempt to connect to the pre-configured Wi-Fi network (defaultSSAP) used for configuration purposes.

Name: WebServer: AP Enable
Description: Instructs whether the device should create an access point for users who wish to download data from the device using the internal web server.

Name: WebServer: WiFi AP Channel
Description: Specifies the Wi-Fi channel that the Smart Spot uses to set up the web server's access point.

Name: WebServer: WiFi AP SSID
Description: Specifies the Wi-Fi SSID that the Smart Spot uses to set up the web server's access point.

Name: WebServer: WiFi AP password
Description: Specifies the Wi-Fi password that the Smart Spot uses to set up the web server's access point.

Name: APN
Description: Specifies the APN (Access Point Name) that the Smart Spot will use to connect to the internet via M2M.

Name: APN Login
Description: Specifies the APN (Access Point Name) login that the Smart Spot will use to connect to the internet via M2M.

Name: APN Password
Description: Specifies the APN (Access Point Name) password that the Smart Spot will use to connect to the internet via M2M.

Name: SIM PIN
Description: Specifies the SIM PIN used to unlock the SIM card if a PIN is required.

Name: Air Quality Endpoint
Description: Specifies the URL endpint used by the SmartSpot to reach the Air Quality Enhancement Service.

Name: Air Quality AI Extra Parameters
Description: specifies the additional parameters to be included when the SmartSpot queries the Air Quality Enhancement Service.

Name: Air Pump Speed
Description: Specifies the speed of the pump used to measure air quality. This value is established during the manufacturing or maintenance process.

Name: Calibrate Sonometer
Description: Instructs to the device to carry out a calibration based on a reference provided. Please note that this resource should not be executed without a reference being exposed to the device. This process is carried out during the manufacturing or maintenance phase.

Name: Calibration Reference
Description: Specifies the reference value that is exposed to the device during the calibration process. The common values used by references are 94dB or 114dB.

Name: Offset
Description: Specifies a fine-grained offset configured specifically for this sensor.

Name: Short Interval
Description: Specifies the short counter interval (in minutes). This is also utilised as a report interval for both CFO and CFE reports. It is imperative that it is always lower than the medium and long counter intervals.

Name: Medium Interval
Description: Specifies the medium counter interval (in minutes). It is imperative that it is always greater than the short interval and less than the long interval.

Name: Long Interval
Description: Specifies the long counter interval (in minutes). It is imperative that it is always greater than the short and medium intervals.

Name: Threshold WiFi
Description: Specifies the dB threshold used to filter detections by distance in Wi-Fi technology. (-120dB is the maximum distance).

Name: Threshold BLE
Description: Specifies the dB threshold used to filter detections by distance in BLE technology. (-120dB is the maximum distance).

Name: MAC Filter
Description: Specifies the MAC randomisation filter that is used to filter detections. (1 = Count/Report non-randomised MACs / 2 = Count/Report randomised MACs / 3 = Count/Report all detected MACs).

Name: Technology Filter
Description: Specifies the technology used for the detection. (0 = WiFi+BLE / 1 = WiFi / 2 = BLE).

Name: Enable Report MAC
Description: Specifies whether the device should report all the detected MACs and their related information. Please be advised that selecting this option will result in an increase in data transmission consumption.
